svg.title: Кистевое вращение с гантелью — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow white contour, vector traced. Two close views from waist: seated, elbow bent 90, forearm supported on thigh and hand beyond knee. One hand grips single dumbbell shaft centrally. First palm up, second palm down, rotation about long axis of forearm. Same supported elbow and neutral wrist, recognizable two dumbbell ends. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
